column1: ## Depth by guild (positions.jsonl, one row per living body at every 100 s). Depth is positive metres below the waterline. q1 is the shallow quartile and q3 the deep one, so L1's "third quartile shallower than 15 m" is the q3 depth column. A guild is the flag the harness wrote: leaf = photosynthetic, stomach = absorptive, mixo = both.
